Name: Morris - but he's a scarecrow now.
Author: HoolOfTheNorth
Description: This is just a texture replacer.[b] Download the file, then replace the "Craftables.xnb" in "[/b][b]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\TileSheets"[/b] or wherever your texture files are stored. You should probably also keep a copy of the original "Craftables.xnb" as well, both as backup and because sometimes you might not want a Morris scarecrow. Y'know.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
